## Milestone / Release Traceability Checklist

- [ ] If milestone status changed, I updated `milestones.md`.
- [ ] If milestone status changed, I updated `RELEASES.md` with candidate/final SHA and tag details.
- [ ] If a milestone is complete, I created and verified a signed tag (`git tag -v` and `git verify-tag`).
- [ ] User-facing milestone/version messaging is aligned with docs.
